title: evaluation.insufficient_evidence.v1
description: Evaluation ran and declined to conclude. A distinct event rather than a low score, because the core invariant is that unknown evidence is never coerced into a numeric result; a consumer that received a score here would rank a candidate on silence.

uncovered_competency_ids.description: Which competencies had too little evidence. Identifiers rather than names, so a consumer resolves them under its own authority.
